messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release v1.12.4 -> payment-service on prod (us-east-1). Canary 10% across pods. Link: https://deployments.redwood/v1.12.4 :rocket:

emma: @oncall-pager pinged — I'm oncall, will watch canary.

luis: seeing spike in 500s for payments-canary-0 logs: `KMS: Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException` (stack snippet)

marta: tagging support — which KMS key did this deploy expect? We rotated keys this morning.

emma: checking deploy config... `env: KMS_KEY_ID` on canary pods is set to `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/old-key-id`

raj: that's the rotated (old) key. New key is arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/new-rotated-id. Looks like the image baked with old env var.

luis: logs show error: 
```
2026-03-15T14:12:02Z ERROR payment-service: failed to decrypt payment_token: AccessDeniedException: User: role/redwood-canary cannot use key key/old-key-id
```

emma: impact: canary only so far (10%) but errors are returning 500 -> users hitting those pods get checkout failures. Estimated requests failing ~2% of overall traffic; immediate mitigation needed to prevent ripple.

marta: mitigation options: 1) update env var on canary pods to new key id and restart pods 2) kill the canary (feature flag/traffic shift) 3) rollback deploy to prior revision

emma: executing kill-switch for the canary traffic now: `./ffctl kill payments_canary` — switching traffic back to stable

deploy-bot: Feature flag `payments_canary` toggled OFF by emma (uid: emma)

luis: confirmed traffic shifted, error rate for payments service dropped to baseline within 40s :thumbsup: 

emma: still want root cause — why did deploy use old KMS key? On release job, secrets manager rotation hook should've updated image config.

raj: digging into CI job: `deploy/ci-reconcile-secrets` log shows `WARN: secret:KMS_KEY_ID missing in envmap; using fallback from build-time` — build-time env contained old key id.

marta: looks like secret sync failed earlier around 12:05 UTC when KMS rotation ran — failing IAM perms during rotation step.

emma: action items: 1) rollback canary change (already killed), 2) patch deploy pipeline to surface missing secret sync as FAIL, not WARN, 3) rotate/migrate any canary pods with stuck env.

luis: I can push a one-off patch to update env var on canary pods and restart, but we've already shifted traffic away. We should still fix CI for next deploy.

raj: I'll open a quick PR to make secret-sync fatal and add a `kubectl rollout undo` in the release job on failure. PR: https://github.com/redwood/deploy/pull/789

marta: paging SRE lead @alex for postmortem and KMS perms audit. alex: can you join?

alex: on it, joining in 5. From initial glance, rotation lambda's role lost kms:Decrypt for the build-service role — will escalate to infra to restore.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-042 (priority P2) — incident channel: #incidents. Paging SRE lead.

emma: handoff — I'm going offline in 25m, raj will be primary after that. raj — can you own communications to support and SOC? I'll write a short blurb for support now.

emma (support blurb draft): "We observed a limited canary failure in payments after a KMS key rotation; we have stopped canary traffic and customers should be back to normal. Team is investigating root cause; if you see customer escalations, please route to #incidents and include INC-20260315-042."

support-sig: Received and posted to #support-ops. We'll route incoming tickets accordingly.

luis: follow-ups: add CI alert -> on missing secret sync; add canary health check to fail-fast; add post-deploy verification to ensure `KMS_KEY_ID` resolves and `kms:Decrypt` succeeds for service role.

raj: timeline note for postmortem: 14:11 UTC canary started, 14:13 first 500s observed, 14:15 kill-switch applied, 14:16 traffic restored to stable, 14:20 incident created. Root cause likely permission regression during rotation at 12:05 UTC.

emma: good. I'll create the incident doc and assign owners for action items. tagging @marta @luis @raj @alex

marta: adding remediation checklist to incident doc: verify KMS roles, re-run rotation, run integration test to validate decrypt path.

emma: closing thread for now — will update incident doc with final postmortem once infra confirms perms fixed. :white_check_mark:
